reviews.text: So I bought it because Soobin used it and I was curious.. And it's so good??? To people with oily skin like me, it's really worth buying. It cleans your face so good. Definitely one of my best buys. I'd repurchase.
reviews.zh: 所以我買咗，因為 Soobin 用過，我好好奇……但係，真係好好啊！！對於油性皮膚嘅人，呢款真係值得買。佢潔面效果好好。係我最好嘅購買之一。我會再買。

reviews.text: i've been using this for years! gives you that squeaky clean feeling without stripping or being too drying. works well for my combination skin. you only need a pea sized amount so one tube lasts forever.
reviews.zh: 我用咗好多年！令你有種乾淨到吱吱聲嗰種清爽感，但唔會剝奪或過份乾燥。啱我嘅混合皮膚。只需要豌豆咁大嘅份量，一支可以用好耐。

reviews.text: I've struggled with constant acne for years and this cleared most of it up. this is my second tube, the previous lasted me a year because it's so creamy you'll only need a little. a bit drying but not as drying as an actual acne treatment so just make sure to hydrate and moisturise.
reviews.zh: 我好多年都有恆常暗瘡問題，呢款令大部分嘅暗瘡都清咗。呢個係我嘅第二支，上一支用咗我一年，因為佢好綿密，只需要少少。有啲乾，但係冇暗瘡治療劑咁乾，所以記得補水同保濕。

reviews.text: I have combined skin and have been using this for months now. It is a very foamy cleanser that cleans very well and it removes any leftover makeup. After using it I can see my pores have reduced and my skin is not as oily as it used to be. I feel very fresh after using it and it doesn't make my skin dry like other cleansers tend to. I really recommend this!!
reviews.zh: 我係混合皮膚，用咗幾個月。佢係好多泡嘅潔面產品，清潔效果好好，仲可以清走殘留嘅化妝。用完之後，我見到我嘅毛孔收細咗，皮膚冇咁油。用完感覺好清新，而且唔似其他潔面產品咁令皮膚乾。我真係推薦！！

reviews.text: I have combined skin and have been using this for months now. It is a very foamy cleanser that cleans very well and it removes any leftover makeup. After using it I can see my pores have reduced and my skin is not as oily as it used to be. I feel very fresh after using it and it doesn't make my skin dry like other cleansers tend to. I really recommend this!!
reviews.zh: 我係混合皮膚，用咗幾個月。佢係好多泡嘅潔面產品，清潔效果好好，仲可以清走殘留嘅化妝。用完之後，我見到我嘅毛孔收細咗，皮膚冇咁油。用完感覺好清新，而且唔似其他潔面產品咁令皮膚乾。我真係推薦！！

reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by Ma:nyo's Cleansing Soda Foam. It cleanses really well without leaving that tight feeling that many other cleansing foams leave behind. After using it, my skin feels very soft and fresh. I still have to keep using it to see long-term results, but for now I love how it leaves my skin clean and comfortable. A good option for everyday use!
reviews.zh: 我對 Ma:nyo 嘅 Cleansing Soda Foam 好驚喜。清潔效果好好，唔似其他好多潔面泡沫咁令皮膚繃緊。用完皮膚感覺好軟、好清新。我仍然要繼續用，先睇到長期效果，但係暫時我好鍾意佢令皮膚保持乾淨同舒服。係日常用嘅一個好選擇！

reviews.text: I've been using this for 5 months and I really liked it. The foam is creamy and soft and has a slight smell of green tea (?). It cleans the skin really good, although it leaves my skin a little dry (not too much though). My nose pores have reduced a lot, so it definitely worked for me. I have sensitive skin and didn't have any reactions :)
reviews.zh: 我用咗 5 個月，好鍾意。泡沫幼滑、軟綿，帶少少綠茶味（？）。清潔效果好好，不過皮膚有少少乾（唔算太多）。我嘅鼻頭毛孔收細咗好多，所以對我好有效。我皮膚敏感，都冇出現任何反應 :)

reviews.text: I use this after I use an oil cleanser and my skin feels so soft and all of my makeup is removed. You can also just use it by itself if you have on no or light makeup on. The cleanser is very soothing and not too drying on your skin.
reviews.zh: 我用油性潔面之後用呢款，皮膚感覺好軟，所有化妝都卸晒。如果你冇化妝或者化妝好淡，都可以單獨用。呢款潔面好舒緩，唔會令皮膚太乾。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
